title: 香港公園體育館羽毛球場預訂
title_en: Badminton Court Booking — Hong Kong Park Sports Centre
description: 位於中環心臟地帶的室內冷氣羽毛球場。可透過 SmartPLAY 系統於7天前預訂場地。
description_en: Indoor air-conditioned badminton courts in the heart of Central. Bookings open 7 days in advance via SmartPLAY.

title: 香港壁球中心壁球場租訂
title_en: Squash Court Session — Hong Kong Squash Centre
description: 鄰近香港公園的專用壁球中心，設有多個符合國際標準的玻璃後牆壁球場。
description_en: Specialized squash facility next to Hong Kong Park offering multiple standard glass-back courts.

title: 中山紀念公園游泳池公眾暢泳（冬季設有暖水）
title_en: Public Swimming (Winter Heated Pool) — Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park Swimming Pool

location.venue: Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park Swimming Pool
location.address: 16 Eastern Street North, Sai Ying Pun

description: 設有面向維多利亞港的50米室內主池及訓練池，冬季（11月中至翌年4月中）提供暖水游泳設施。
description_en: Indoor 50-metre competition pool and training pool overlooking Victoria Harbour. Heated facilities are provided during winter (mid-November to mid-April).

title: 駱克道體育館乒乓球室活動
title_en: Indoor Table Tennis — Lockhart Road Sports Centre
description: 鄰近灣仔港鐵站的乒乓球室，配套齊全，方便平日下班或週末休閒切磋。
description_en: Equipped table tennis rooms located right next to Wan Chai MTR station. Easy for casual evening matches.

title: 維多利亞公園網球場租用
title_en: Outdoor Tennis Court Booking — Victoria Park Tennis Courts
description: 銅鑼灣維多利亞公園內的多個標準硬地網球場，設有夜間照明系統。
description_en: Standard hard-surface outdoor tennis courts located in Causeway Bay with floodlight facilities for night play.

title: 港島東體育館室內運動攀登牆體驗
title_en: Public Indoor Climbing Wall — Island East Sports Centre

location.address: 52 Lei King Road, Sai Wan Ho

description: 設於港島東體育館的室內攀石牆，提供頂繩及先鋒攀登路線，合資格人士可租用。
description_en: LCSD certified indoor climbing wall featuring top-rope and lead routes for accredited climbers.

title: 創興水上活動中心獨木舟水上活動
title_en: Water Sports & Sea Kayak Rental — Chong Hing Water Sports Centre
description: 萬宜水庫西壩創興水上活動中心，提供獨木舟、直立板及滑浪風帆日租與活動體驗。
description_en: Kayak, canoe, and windsurfing day rentals on High Island Reservoir. Scenic and serene water environment.

title: 修頓遊樂場戶外籃球對抗賽
title_en: Outdoor Basketball Casual Pickup — Southorn Playground
description: 香港極具標誌性的街頭籃球聖地，免費開放公眾即場組隊打半場及全場比賽。
description_en: Hong Kong's famous urban basketball hotspot. Open to the public for free walk-in half-court and full-court pickup.

title: 九龍公園游泳池公眾暢泳（冬季設有暖水）
title_en: Public Swimming (Winter Heated Pool) — Kowloon Park Swimming Pool

location.address: 22 Austin Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon

description: 尖沙咀奧運標準室內游泳池，設有主池與跳水池，冬季（11月中至翌年4月中）提供暖水設施。
description_en: Premier Olympic-standard swimming complex in Tsim Sha Tsui featuring indoor pools and diving facilities. Heated pool facilities operate during winter (mid-November to mid-April).

title: 沙田賽馬會游泳池公眾暢泳及訓練
title_en: Public Swimming & Lap Training — Sha Tin Jockey Club Swimming Pool

location.venue: Sha Tin Jockey Club Swimming Pool

description: 沙田大型公眾游泳館，設有50米標準主池、訓練池及跳水池，適合休閒游泳與體能訓練。
description_en: Large public swimming complex featuring a standard 50-metre main pool, teaching pool, and diving pool for recreational and lap swimming.

title: 北河街體育館乒乓球切磋時段
title_en: Table Tennis Practice — Pei Ho Street Sports Centre

location.venue: Pei Ho Street Municipal Services Building
location.address: 333 Ki Lung Street, Sham Shui Po

description: 位於深水埗的體育館，乒乓球設施完善，深受學生與附近球友歡迎。
description_en: Convenient venue in Sham Shui Po popular among local students and neighborhood club players.

title: 蕙荃體育館羽毛球雙打時段
title_en: Badminton Play — Wai Tsuen Sports Centre
description: 位於荃灣的寬敞體育館，鋪設專業木地板，非常適合週末相約打雙打。
description_en: Spacious sports hall in Tsuen Wan with modern flooring, ideal for weekend doubles matches.

title: 香港仔體育館壁球場活動
title_en: Public Squash Court — Aberdeen Sports Centre
description: 位於港島南區的體育館，設有多面壁球場，環境清幽且設施齊備。
description_en: Multi-court facility on the south side of Hong Kong Island overlooking Aberdeen Harbour.

title: 九龍灣運動場戶外跑道緩步跑
title_en: Outdoor Jogging & Track Running — Kowloon Bay Sports Ground
description: 400米標準全天候田徑跑道，於指定緩步跑時段免費開放公眾跑步鍛鍊。
description_en: Standard 400m synthetic running track open to the general public during designated jogging hours.

title: 牛池灣體育館公眾射箭體驗場
title_en: Public Archery Practice Session — Ngau Chi Wan Sports Centre

location.venue: Ngau Chi Wan Municipal Services Building

description: 設有室內射箭場地的體育館，供合資格射箭愛好者及初級培訓班使用。
description_en: Indoor archery range designated for certified archers and introductory clinic attendees.

title: 維多利亞公園滾軸溜冰場休閒溜冰
title_en: Outdoor Roller Skating — Victoria Park Roller Skating Rinks
description: 維園內設有兩個專用戶外滾軸溜冰場，平整地面，免費開放公眾進行溜冰及滾軸訓練。
description_en: Two dedicated smooth-surface outdoor roller skating rinks open for free recreational skating.

title: 藍田南體育館壁球場練習時段
title_en: Squash Court Practice — Lam Tin South Sports Centre

location.address: 170 Pik Wan Road, Lam Tin, Kwun Tong

description: 位於東九龍藍田的康體設施，設有標準室內壁球場，可透過 SmartPLAY 系統預約租用。
description_en: Multi-court recreational facility in East Kowloon offering quality indoor squash courts bookable via SmartPLAY.

title: 蒲崗村道體育館羽毛球場
title_en: Badminton Play — Po Kong Village Road Sports Centre

location.venue: Po Kong Village Road Sports Centre
location.address: 120 Po Kong Village Road, Diamond Hill

description: 鑽石山區內大型綜合體育館，設有空調主場及8個羽毛球場，配套完善。
description_en: Modern multi-purpose sports complex in Diamond Hill with air conditioning and 8 badminton courts.

title: 黃金泳灘沙灘排球同樂時段
title_en: Outdoor Beach Volleyball Casual Play — Golden Beach
description: 屯門黃金泳灘設有固定的沙灘排球場地，沙質細膩，免費供市民以先到先得方式使用。
description_en: Hong Kong's premier artificial sand beach with permanent beach volleyball courts available on a first-come, first-served basis.

title: 東涌游泳池公眾暢泳（冬季設有暖水）
title_en: Public Swimming (Winter Heated Pool) — Tung Chung Swimming Pool

location.address: 5 Tat Tung Road, Tung Chung, Lantau Island

description: 大嶼山東涌現代化公眾泳池，設有50米室內主池及室外訓練池，冬季（11月中至翌年4月中）提供暖水設施。
description_en: Public swimming facility on Lantau Island with 50-metre indoor main pool and outdoor training pool. Heated facilities operate during winter (mid-November to mid-April).

title: M+ 視覺文化博物館當代藝術常設展覽
title_en: M+ Museum Contemporary Visual Culture Exhibition
description: 西九文化區地標級博物館，展出20及21世紀來自亞洲及全球的當代視覺藝術、設計、建築及流動影像。
description_en: Explore 20th and 21st-century visual art, design, architecture, and moving image from Asia and worldwide in West Kowloon.

title: 香港故宮文化博物館珍寶專題展
title_en: Hong Kong Palace Museum Treasures Exhibition

location.address: 8 Museum Drive, West Kowloon Cultural District

description: 展出從北京故宮博物院借展的900多件珍貴文物，並透過現代策展視角展現中國古代宮廷藝術與文化。
description_en: Showcasing over 900 priceless treasures on loan from the Palace Museum in Beijing alongside modern interpretations.

title: 大館歷史古蹟與域多利監獄導賞團
title_en: Tai Kwun Heritage & Prison Cell Guided Tour

source.name: Tai Kwun Centre for Heritage and Arts

description: 參觀中區警署建築群活化後的文化藝術空間，探索百年域多利監獄囚室與中央裁判司署歷史。
description_en: Walk through the revitalized Central Police Station compound, Victoria Prison, and the former Central Magistracy.

title: 元創方文創設計小店與週末手作市集
title_en: PMQ Creative Design Studios & Weekend Craft Market
description: 由前荷李活道已婚警察宿舍活化而成的創意地標，匯聚過百位本地獨立設計師、陶藝家與手工藝小店。
description_en: Former Police Married Quarters turned design hub hosting over 100 local designers, ceramicists, and craft makers.

title: 香港藝術館常設展覽與維港藝術漫步
title_en: Hong Kong Museum of Art (HKMoA) Permanent Galleries
description: 座落於尖沙咀海旁的香港藝術館，展出豐富的中國古代文物、水墨畫作以及香港本土現代藝術作品。
description_en: Multi-storey harbourfront museum with Chinese antiquities, modern calligraphy, and contemporary local HK art.

title: 油街實現藝術空間當代藝術展覽與古蹟草坪參觀
title_en: Oi! (Oil Street Art Space) Contemporary Art & Heritage Lawn Visit
description: 由前香港皇家遊艇會會所二級歷史紅磚建築活化而成的藝術空間，定期舉辦當代視覺藝術展覽、大型裝置藝術，並設有免費開放的草坪與公共活動空間。
description_en: Historic Grade II red-brick former yacht club clubhouse revitalized by the Art Promotion Office, featuring free contemporary visual art exhibitions, community creative projects, and open green lawns.

title: 牛棚藝術村歷史建築與駐場藝術家工作室參觀
title_en: Cattle Depot Artist Village Open Studios Walk

location.address: 63 Ma Tau Kok Road, To Kwa Wan

description: 建於1908年的百年紅磚屠房活化成的藝術群落，聚集多個本地前衛藝術團體與獨立工作室。
description_en: Former 1908 slaughterhouse in To Kwa Wan featuring red-brick architecture and independent artist collectives.

title: 灣仔藍屋建築群社區導賞與文化館體驗
title_en: Blue House Heritage Walk & Community Stories
description: 結合「留屋留人」保育理念的灣仔百年藍屋唐樓群，設有香港故事館，展示舊灣仔基層街坊生活歷史。
description_en: Lingnan-style shophouse heritage site with a living community and the Hong Kong House of Stories museum.

title: 香港文化博物館粵劇文物館與武俠金庸館
title_en: Hong Kong Heritage Museum Cantonese Opera Exhibition
description: 座落沙田城門河畔，設有金庸館、李小龍專題展及精緻的粵劇文物館，深具香港本土文化特色。
description_en: Comprehensive museum in Sha Tin featuring permanent exhibitions on Bruce Lee, Jin Yong wuxia literature, and Cantonese opera.

title: 藝穗會爵士樂與獨立原聲音樂之夜
title_en: Fringe Club Independent Jazz & Acoustic Night
description: 位於中環蘭桂坊旁的古蹟紅白磚建築，週末定期舉辦爵士樂表演、獨立樂隊原聲演奏及小劇場演出。
description_en: Historic dairy building in Central hosting intimate weekend jazz sets, comedy open mics, and experimental theatre.

title: 石澳龍脊遠足徑山脊漫遊
title_en: Dragon's Back Trail Ridge Hike

location.address: Shek O Road (Bus 9 from Shau Kei Wan MTR)

description: 享譽國際的香港經典海岸山徑，沿途可眺望石澳泳灘、大浪灣及南中國海壯麗全景，交通便利。
description_en: World-renowned coastal ridge hike offering sweeping panoramic views of Shek O Beach, Big Wave Bay, and the South China Sea.

title: 獅子山晨光登頂遠足
title_en: Lion Rock Summit Morning Hike
description: 攀登象徵香港拼搏精神的獅子山，俯瞰九龍半島棋盤街道與對岸維港天際線，風景極具震撼力。
description_en: Climb Hong Kong's symbolic mountain overlooking Kowloon Peninsula and Victoria Harbour. Steep stair ascent rewarded by iconic views.

title: 麥理浩徑第二段：萬宜水庫東壩至大浪灣健行
title_en: MacLehose Trail Section 2: High Island to Tai Long Wan
description: 走訪聯合國教科文組織世界地質公園六角形岩柱，並徒步探訪浪茄及大浪西灣天然海灘。
description_en: Explore Hexagonal rock columns at East Dam and trek to Hong Kong's most pristine white-sand surf beaches.

title: 南丫島家樂徑漫步（榕樹灣至索罟灣）
title_en: Lamma Island Family Trail Walk (Yung Shue Wan to Sok Kwu Wan)

location.venue: Ferry from Central Pier 4 to Yung Shue Wan

description: 平緩易走的島嶼漫步路線，途經文青風情的榕樹灣咖啡館小店、洪聖爺泳灘及索罟灣海鮮街。
description_en: Gentle island walking trail connecting Yung Shue Wan's indie cafes and craft shops to Sok Kwu Wan seafood village.

title: 長洲單車環島遊與傳統街頭美食漫步
title_en: Cheung Chau Island Cycling & Heritage Food Trail

location.venue: Ferry from Central Pier 5 to Cheung Chau

description: 租單車悠閒穿梭長洲小巷，走訪古老北帝廟、探訪張保仔洞，品嚐著名芒果糯米糍與大魚蛋。
description_en: Rent a bicycle to explore Pak Tai Temple, pirate Cheung Po Tsai Cave, and taste local mango mochi and fish balls.

title: 城門水塘白千層林道與水浸白千層生態漫遊
title_en: Shing Mun Reservoir Paperbark Tree Forest Walk
description: 荃灣城門水塘環塘步道，沿途擁有著名的白千層樹林與水浸白千層奇景，偶遇野生猴子與水牛。
description_en: Picturesque freshwater reservoir walk lined with paperbark trees and scenic lakeside picnic spots in Tsuen Wan.

title: 大東山秋冬芒草與石屋群登山遠足
title_en: Sunset Peak (Tai Tung Shan) Silvergrass Trek
description: 攀登大嶼山第三高峰大東山，秋冬季節滿山芒草搖曳，配以爛頭營古老石屋群，景色絕美。
description_en: Ascend Lantau Island's third-highest peak famous for expansive silvergrass fields and mountain stone cabins.

title: 新娘潭與照鏡潭自然教育徑瀑布漫遊
title_en: Bride's Pool & Mirror Pool Waterfall Nature Trail
description: 位於新界東北船灣郊野公園的自然教育徑，沿途探訪新娘潭瀑布及照鏡潭瀑布，林蔭清幽。
description_en: Easy scenic forest trail visiting twin natural waterfalls and geological plunge pools in northeastern New Territories.

title: 太平山盧吉道晨間環山步道維港全景走
title_en: Victoria Peak Lugard Road Morning Sky Walk
description: 沿太平山盧吉道開鑿於懸崖峭壁旁的平緩環山林蔭步道，可無遮擋俯瞰維港兩岸摩天大樓全景。
description_en: Flat, paved cliffside loop around The Peak providing the most famous postcard vista of Hong Kong's skyline.

title: 大潭水務文物徑英倫風石橋與水塘健行
title_en: Tai Tam Waterworks Heritage Trail Hike
description: 穿越大潭水塘群，欣賞21座被列為古蹟的維多利亞時代英式花崗岩拱橋、石砌大壩及輸水道。
description_en: Trek across historic Victorian granite bridges, masonry dams, and aqueducts built between 1883 and 1917.

title: 灣仔粵語英語語言交換聚會
title_en: Cantonese-English Language Exchange Meetup — Wan Chai
description: 每週舉辦的輕鬆語言文化交流小組，安排非本地學生與本地雙語青年同桌交流，練習實用廣東話。
description_en: Weekly friendly table conversation matching international students with local bilingual youth over coffee.

title: 聖雅各福群會土作坊陶藝拉坯體驗工作坊
title_en: Beginner Ceramic Pottery Workshop — St. James' Creation
description: 由社會企業工藝導師帶領的陶藝拉坯與捏陶手作工作坊，學習製作屬於自己的陶瓷杯或器皿。
description_en: Hand-building and wheel-throwing ceramic workshop led by local artisan instructors in a social enterprise setting.

title: 旺角國際學生桌遊桌上遊戲同樂日
title_en: International Student Board Games Social — Mong Kok

location.address: 11/F, 240 Sai Yeung Choi Street South, Mong Kok

description: 藏有超過300款中英雙語派對與策略桌上遊戲，設有專業店員教學，適合同學結伴認識新朋友。
description_en: Casual Saturday games gathering featuring over 300 modern board games with English and bilingual rule explainers.

title: 龍鼓灘海岸清潔志願者義工活動
title_en: Community Coastal Clean-up Volunteer Day — Lung Kwu Tan

source.name: Ocean Park Conservation Foundation Hong Kong

description: 參與本地環保組織舉辦的週末海灘清潔行動，共同清理海岸垃圾，認識香港海洋微塑膠問題。
description_en: Join local environmental volunteer teams to remove plastic waste from natural beaches and learn about marine ecology.

title: 傳統香港霓虹燈手作體驗工作坊
title_en: Traditional Hong Kong Neon Sign Making Workshop
description: 深入了解香港即將消失的霓虹夜景招牌歷史，在導師指導下利用冷光線親手製作屬於自己的微型霓虹燈牌。
description_en: Learn the history of Hong Kong's fading neon craft and create your own customized illuminated mini-sign using EL-wire.

title: MakerBay 創客空間3D打印與激光切割初階導引
title_en: MakerBay Digital Fabrication & 3D Printing Induction

location.address: 45 Pak Tin Par Street, Tsuen Wan

description: 為創客與學生設計的入門工作坊，認識激光切割機、3D立體打印機操作及快速原型製作概念。
description_en: Hands-on maker induction session introducing laser cutting, 3D printing, and rapid prototyping for student inventors.

title: 國際十字路會物資整理與體驗志工日
title_en: Volunteering with Crossroads Foundation — Global Village
description: 在屯門前軍營參與人道救援物資分類包裝志願服務，並可參與國際貧困模擬工作坊。
description_en: Sort donated humanitarian goods and participate in empathy simulation workshops at the former Perowne Barracks in Tuen Mun.

title: 香港中央圖書館月度讀書會與專題講座
title_en: Hong Kong Central Library Monthly Book Talk & Reading Club
description: 位於銅鑼灣的中央圖書館主辦的讀書分享會，圍繞香港本土歷史小說、都市社會學及亞洲文學展開討論。
description_en: Engage in literary discussions focusing on Hong Kong local literature and Asian urban sociology in Causeway Bay.

title: 南豐紗廠紡織文化導賞與永續時尚巡禮
title_en: The Mills Textile Heritage Tour & Sustainable Fashion Walk

source.name: Centre for Heritage, Arts and Textile (CHAT)

location.address: 45 Pak Tin Par Street, Tsuen Wan

description: 走進由昔日大型棉紡織廠活化而成的南豐紗廠，參觀六廠紡織文化藝術館（CHAT），回顧香港紡織工業黃金時代。
description_en: Guided walking tour through Nan Fung Cotton Mills revitalization, CHAT (Centre for Heritage, Arts and Textile).

title: 鰂魚涌室內抱石攀岩社交攀爬時段
title_en: Bouldering & Climbing Social Session — Verm City

location.address: 4/F, Kodak House II, 321 Java Road, Quarry Bay

description: 位於鰂魚涌的室內大型抱石館，路線豐富適合初學者至進階攀登者，常有大專學生社團交流聚會。
description_en: Spacious commercial bouldering gym in Quarry Bay with climbing problems from V0 to V8 and social climbing groups.

title: 廟街夜市大排檔與特色地道街頭小食巡禮
title_en: Temple Street Night Market & Street Food Evening Walk
description: 油麻地經典夜市，漫步於煲仔飯香、海鮮大牌檔、街頭粵劇榕樹頭點唱以及復古小攤檔之間。
description_en: Vibrant night bazaar in Yau Ma Tei featuring claypot rice, seafood dai pai dongs, open-air Cantonese opera, and souvenirs.

title: 深水埗黃金電腦商場與鴨寮街布藝尋寶散策
title_en: Sham Shui Po Electronics & Fabric Market Thrift Walk
description: 探索全港電子零件與數碼勝地鴨寮街、黃金電腦商場，以及汝州街傳統手作花邊鈕扣特色街區。
description_en: Explore electronics paradise Apliu Street, Golden Computer Arcade, and traditional fabric & button shops on Yu Chau Street.

title: 黃大仙祠道教建築與求籤文化探秘
title_en: Wong Tai Sin Temple Architecture & Taoist Culture Tour

source.name: Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple

location.address: 2 Chuk Yuen Village, Wong Tai Sin

description: 參觀香火鼎盛的嗇色園黃大仙祠，欣賞金碧輝煌的九龍壁與傳統宮殿式建築，體驗香港求籤解籤文化。
description_en: Visit Hong Kong's famous three-religions shrine, renowned for its ornate Chinese imperial architecture and traditional divination stalls.

title: 大澳水鄉棚屋風情與中華白海豚出海尋訪
title_en: Tai O Fishing Village Stilt House & Dolphin Boat Excursion

location.address: Lantau Island (Bus 11 from Tung Chung MTR)

description: 漫步大澳棚屋水上聚落，探訪百年傳統蝦膏蝦醬工場，並乘駁艇出海尋找中華白海豚蹤影。
description_en: Historic stilt village known as the 'Venice of the East' with traditional shrimp paste factories and Chinese white dolphin boat tours.

title: 鯉魚門海鮮村古樸漁村與舊石礦場廢墟探索
title_en: Lei Yue Mun Historic Seafood Village & Old Quarry Walk
description: 擁有數百年石礦及捕魚歷史的鯉魚門，漫步海鮮小街、天后古廟及舊石礦場壯闊水邊廢墟岩壁。
description_en: Quaint village with centuries of maritime heritage, fresh seafood stalls, and the scenic Lei Yue Mun Lighthouse and stone quarry.

title: 旺角花墟與園蒲街雀鳥花園悠閒晨間漫步
title_en: Flower Market & Yuen Po Bird Garden Morning Stroll
description: 清晨造訪芳香四溢的旺角花墟，並漫步至園蒲街中式庭園風格的雀鳥花園，感受老香港悠閒情調。
description_en: Fragrant morning stroll through Mong Kok's bustling exotic plant stalls and traditional Chinese songbird pavilions.

title: 九龍寨城公園江南園林與昔日寨城遺蹟探索
title_en: Kowloon Walled City Park Historical Garden Tour
description: 在昔日傳奇九龍寨城舊址上建立的典雅江南園林，完整保留清代大鵬協府衙門古蹟、古炮及微縮模型。
description_en: Traditional Jiangnan garden built over the ruins of the infamous Kowloon Walled City, preserving the Yamen and cannons.

title: 屏山文物徑鄧氏宗祠與聚星樓歷史步道
title_en: Ping Shan Heritage Trail Ancient Ancestral Halls Walk

location.venue: Starts at Tsui Sing Lau Pagoda
location.address: Tin Shui Wai MTR Station Exit E3

description: 香港首條文物徑，沿途探訪新界鄧氏宗族擁有600年歷史的祠堂、古廟及香港唯一現存古塔聚星樓。
description_en: Hong Kong's first heritage trail visiting the 600-year-old Tang Clan Ancestral Hall and the ancient Tsui Sing Lau Pagoda.

title: 九龍城「小泰國」地道泰式美食與香料店漫遊
title_en: Kowloon City Little Thailand Culinary Exploration

location.venue: South Wall Road & Nga Tsin Wai Road

description: 漫步九龍城著名泰國文化商圈，品嚐地道泰國船麵、惹味炭火串燒、芒果糯米飯及選購進口香料食材。
description_en: Explore Hong Kong's culinary hub for authentic Thai groceries, lemongrass grilled skewers, boat noodles, and mango sticky rice.

title: 重慶大廈多元族裔文化漫遊與正宗南亞咖哩品嚐
title_en: Chungking Mansions Cultural Tour & South Asian Cuisine
description: 走訪尖沙咀重慶大廈這座世界級多元文化微縮聚落，品嚐正宗印度脆角、巴基斯坦香料飯及拉茶。
description_en: Discover the global micro-community inside Tsim Sha Tsui's Chungking Mansions and enjoy authentic Pakistani biryani and samosas.

title: 指南：康文署 SmartPLAY 康體通系統註冊與訂場教學

description_en: How to register your Hong Kong ID or student visa at any public library branch to access physical books, digital academic databases, and study carrels.

title: 指南：香港夏季遠足防中暑與登山安全必讀守則
title_en: Guide: Hong Kong Summer Hiking Safety & Heat Preparedness
description: 香港夏季行山必備指南：包括每小時飲水量計算、酷熱天氣警告應對、防曬防蚊及緊急求救112定位教學。
